info.name: AISafe - Aircraft & Maintenance Component (Assignment 1 - 3 Instances & Inter-Service)
info.description:
Comprehensive test collection demonstrating:
1. Authentication (JWT token issuance across instances)
2. Health checks for all 3 instances (:8081, :8082, :8083)
3. Local data access on all 3 instances
4. Multi-Peer Peer-to-Peer HTTP GET Forwarding across 3 Replicas (non-binary mesh)
5. Resilience & Error Handling (Cluster 404 and offline peer handling)
6. Loop prevention via X-Peer-Forwarded header
7. Inter-Service Communication with airports-routes-service (:8092)
